Synopsis:
Incheon airport topped global international passenger rankings in H1 2026 with 38.39M passengers, partly driven by Middle East hub disruption from the US-Iran conflict rerouting transfer traffic through East Asia. Heathrow ranked second. Dubai-area hub weakness and a 16.5% capacity drop to the Middle East at Heathrow underscore ongoing aviation network reshuffling away from the Gulf region.
